title: Update of the risk assessment on 3-monochloropropane diol and its fatty acid esters
authors: EFSA Panel on Contaminants in the Food Chain (CONTAM), Knutsen HK, Alexander J, Barregård L, Bignami M, Brüschweiler B, et al.
funder: European Food Safety Authority (requestor: EFSA; Question number EFSA-Q-2016-00839).
result: Group tolerable daily intake for 3-MCPD and its fatty acid esters revised from 0.8 to 2 µg/kg body weight per day, based on a BMDL10 of 0.20 mg/kg bw per day for renal tubular hyperplasia in male rats; not exceeded in the adult population, slightly exceeded in high consumers among younger age groups.
